name: blast-radius
description: Holds a risky shell command and shows what it would change, with Proceed and Cancel buttons. Your own preCheck command can clear the ones you already trust.

preCheck.title: Pre-check command
preCheck.description: Optional shell command run before a risky command is held, as `<preCheck> <kind> <command>`. If it exits 0 and prints exactly `approve`, the command runs with no panel. Anything else holds it as usual. Leave empty to hold every risky command.
